correctness.rationale: The patch replaces the two hard-coded install.sh/test.sh checks with an array over all five requested glob patterns (*.sh, scripts/*.sh, scripts/checks/*.sh, scripts/setup/*.sh, scripts/lib/*.sh), enables nullglob before expansion, and loops with bash -n plus independent pass()/fail() per file—matching the parser-only, explicit-glob, per-file reporting contract. Minor deduction because bash -n stderr is suppressed on the failure path (2>/dev/null), so syntax-error diagnostics are not surfaced when fail() fires, and bundle evidence cannot confirm whether expanded coverage revealed latent syntax errors elsewhere requiring fixes in the same diff.

quality.rationale: Implementation is minimal and readable with a straightforward array-and-loop structure, and AI_REPO_GUIDE.md is appropriately synced to document the widened coverage. Deductions for stderr suppression hiding failure diagnostics, no inline comments documenting the explicit glob set or nullglob rationale, unquoted inner-loop glob expansion (fragile for unusual filenames), and diff churn in three .context/state session files unrelated to maintainable production code.

process.rationale: AI_REPO_GUIDE doc-sync and a referenced plan in session state show partial process discipline, but the diff includes three forbidden .context/state files (objective forbidden-path and scope penalties), task record still marks verification, negative smoke, and commit as incomplete, and the PR is not scoped to the check plus required doc-sync alone.

reliability.rationale: Objective evidence confirms test wiring (6/6) and bash_n_check_script pass on the changed script, and the diff integrates with existing pass/fail helpers. Bundle lacks full_test_sh execution (skipped in bundle-only grading), no reported bash test.sh or narrow syntax-check output, task record explicitly leaves negative-smoke verification unchecked, and no demonstration that a deliberate syntax error is caught and cleared.

uncertainty_notes: Bundle contains no bash test.sh run output, narrow syntax-check output, or negative-smoke demonstration/explanation required by acceptance criteria; reliability scored conservatively.
Cannot confirm from bundle alone whether expanding coverage would have revealed latent syntax errors elsewhere requiring fixes in the same diff.
